title: Oct 28 Results: When the Numbers Humble You
summary: A tough night in Tampa — breaking down what went wrong on Oct 28

content.value:
## Here's the Thing About Baseball

Sometimes the game reminds you why they play it on the field and not on a spreadsheet. October 28th was one of those nights — a single game on the schedule, and we swung and missed.

## The Tampa Bay Story

We backed the Rays at home with 57% confidence against the Brewers. On paper, it made sense — home field advantage, solid pitching matchup, the numbers leaning our way. But the Brewers had other plans, and that's the beautiful frustration of this game we love.

## What We're Learning

A 57% confidence pick isn't a guarantee — it never is. That means we expected the Rays to win about 3 out of every 5 times in this scenario. Tonight just happened to be one of those other 2 times. The math doesn't change, but it's a good reminder that even when the odds are in your favor, baseball has a way of keeping you honest.
